name: STAR Assurance — orbital-elements conversion cross-audit
summary: Cross-audit of state-vector to classical-elements implementations (Vallado rv2coe via python-sgp4, hapsira, skyfield, star_elements) validated on Vallado Example 2-5; regular-case envelopes and a map of singular-case conventions.
reference: Vallado, Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications, Example 2-5 (rv2coe)
reference_observed: all 4 implementations reproduce Example 2-5 within the printed precision (max 0.0083 km in p, 0.0049 deg in argp); a textbook reference decoder recovers the generator truth to < 1e-7; known-defect drivers (0.02 deg inclination offset, sentinel, NaN) classified exactly

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-06: published example cited in source; corpus generated in-repo and sha256-pinned; documented APIs only
review.G-08: subprocess only for the audited implementation; cases via stdin; runner names prefixed
review.G-13: failed run raises with stderr tail; refusals counted per implementation; unvalidated implementations excluded
